item.text: The offset needs to reach the transcoding cache key as well as FFmpeg; otherwise a cached stream from one start time could be served for another. I’m adding it to both paths.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "grep -RIn 'timeOffset\\|transcodeOffset\\|streamTimeOffset\\|stream.*offset' . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*.sum' | head -n 80; sed -n '55,75p' utils/request_helpers.go; sed -n '180,205p' core/archiver_test.go; sed -n '145,160p' core/archiver.go; ls server/public/*test.go server/subsonic/*test.go"
